mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour Cumulative Volume Delta crossover of its fixed twenty-period exponential signal identifies a reversal in persistent aggressive buyer-versus-seller pressure; follow the new relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when CVD crosses strictly above its EMA(20); short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: CVD accumulates directly observed taker-buy quote notional minus inferred taker-sell quote notional. It is not OBV, price-volume trend, normalized same-day intrinsic flow, close-location weighting, rolling money flow, raw price momentum, prior candidate repair, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse continuous aggressive-notional path reversals are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), including quote_asset_volume and taker_buy_quote
features.aggressive_quote_delta: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume) over the completed block, finite; each source row requires 0<=taker_buy_quote<=quote_asset_volume
features.cvd: causal cumulative aggressive_quote_delta, reset across source gaps
features.signal: causal EMA(20) of CVD with alpha=2/21, emitted after full warmup
features.event: current finite nonzero CVD-signal sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical continuous CVD with preregistered EMA(20) signal crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no signal period, CVD formula, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: bar delta=taker buy volume-taker sell volume; CVD is its causal cumulative sum; fixed causal EMA(20) signal crossover
external_basis.selection_use: published aggressive-volume delta construction and one preregistered twenty-period signal only; no incidence or outcomes
